title: Mycraft
body:
## This modpack was created solely for my own enjoyment !

I'm so fed up with Minecraft's performance optimization and the lack of features it offers. Mojang didn't add what we needed, like The End Update. Instead, they updated it with cuteness features in update 26. I'm really disappointed, Mojang!

That's why I created this modpack to satisfy myself. It's a complete overhaul of all the **Terrain** and **Structures** in Minecraft, including the **Nether** and **The** **End**, while retaining the original **Vanilla** feel. And I've also brought down some features from version 1.21.11 just to satisfy the experience of playing in the new version and having a variety of mods.

![Village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b69581c7fffec0f7cce32d7a53a156a27cfd4e91_0.webp)

**Note:** Most changes come from datapacks, so there are very few items or anything interesting from the mods. The essence of this modpack is to rework Vanilla's original Survival mode, and I wanted to limit the mod changes to the game mechanics.
